description: Bramble THE ROLL-OVER property (M2 set piece #2, worlds/bramble/rollover_sequence.gd), driven by --rollover (dev/capture force-arm, fires ~3s after load regardless of dream count -- ROLLOVER {"forced":true}). No input needed: both Pip and Otto sit at their spawns until the sequence bubble-lifts them (core/rescue/bubble_effect.gd, which prints no receipt of its own -- watch the PLAYER_POS trajectory instead). Expected receipts: ROLLOVER phase=start (forced:true), the far meadow's collision/visual going live immediately (no fall-through gap), a multi-second PLAYER_POS float of both seats from spawn to the far meadow landing pad (~x=-20/-18.6, z=-52), ROLLOVER phase=end ~8s after start (haunch settle duration), and PLAYER_POS lines for both seats holding steady on solid far-meadow ground afterward -- never a RESCUE line (that would mean a player fell through into the generic rescue net instead of landing on the new ground).
